title: 2005 AMC 8 Problem 11
statement: The sales tax rate in Bergville is \(6\%\). During a sale at the Bergville Coat Closet, the price of a coat is discounted \(20\%\) from its \(\$90.00\) price. Two clerks, Jack and Jill, calculate the bill independently. Jack rings up \(\$90.00\) and adds \(6\%\) sales tax, then subtracts \(20\%\) from this total. Jill rings up \(\$90.00\), subtracts \(20\%\) of the price, then adds \(6\%\) of the discounted price for sales tax. What is Jack’s total minus Jill’s total?

solutions.text:
Jack’s total is \(90.00\cdot1.06\cdot0.80\) dollars.

Jill’s total is \(90.00\cdot0.80\cdot1.06\) dollars.

These products are equal because multiplication is commutative, so Jack’s total minus Jill’s total is \(\$0\).

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Adding tax and taking the discount are both multiplications.
Multiplication gives the same result in either order.
